eip_proposals_glamsterdam.highlight: EIP-8025 (zkEVM stateless inputs) targeting CFI at ACDC tomorrow; attendance encouraged
EIP-7709 (BlockHash via EIP-2935 contract) CFI'd at ACDE; removes 'headers' field from execution witness

testing_progress.highlight: zkVM test release v21 based on Sepolia official tests; public keys field removed from stateless inputs
R2 bucket live for Sepolia stateless inputs (50k+ blocks); Hoodi and mainnet buckets planned as forks activate
Hive consumer now supports REST+SSZ variant of Engine API; Nimbus already merged implementation

zkevm_standards_and_security.highlight: Hash-map collision attack described by Lukasz (Nethermind): all provers for a given zkEVM vulnerable simultaneously; new randomness-seeding standard proposed with OpenVM demo
RISC-V compliance gaps identified across tested zkVM teams; proposal to require tests alongside each new standard

cl_optional_proofs.highlight: Consensus-spec refactor: proof engine scope reduced to verification only; client teams free to embed verifier or use HTTP sidecar
New draft EIP for recursive chain proofs: single proof covering weak-subjectivity checkpoint to head, reducing sync bandwidth by orders of magnitude
EF intends to deploy prover on Sepolia; client teams invited to join and test EIP-8025 on testnet
Prysm proof-of-concept EIP-8025 implementation complete (gnark verifier embedded in binary); running verifier node on Sepolia; incompatibility with Lighthouse 'proof type 0' under investigation
Lighthouse merged proof-engine sidecar support into Unstable; can now run Unstable without an EL; verifiers to be integrated into codebase later

zilkworm_guest_client.highlight: Silkworm Alpha 4 registered in EERE benchmark; passes full zkVM test suite (2 known failures matching Reth); ~half the estimated proving cost of Reth on every block
Alpha 5 target: native stateless input bytes support (no adapter); two failing tests to be fixed
Alpha 2→Alpha 4: one-third reduction in executed cycles; SP1 Hypercube used as benchmark VM
Airbender V3 integration live: ~3.8s proof with two 25090 GPUs; JUMPDEST analysis accounts for up to 30% of EVM execution cycles
Zilkworm now fully open source (SDLC pipeline, CI, PRs all public)
MFBD flat witness format: minimally-perfect-hash-based, zero-copy cast from input bytes; DirectState ~11% faster than full reconstruction from stateless input bytes

action_items.action: Join ACDC tomorrow to support CFI vote for EIP-8025; teams with strong opinions should attend
action_items.owner: EL/CL client teams and zkEVM stakeholders

action_items.action: Agree on Beacon API GET method for execution proofs to support Dora explorer
Discuss upstreaming Zilkworm RISC-V optimizations (memcpy, byte-swap, JUMPDEST) to benefit all guest programs

decisions.decision: EIP-7709 CFI'd at ACDE; removes 'headers' field from execution witness by routing BlockHash through EIP-2935 contract
Proof engine scope in consensus specs narrowed to verification only; proof generation/fetching is unspecified client responsibility

targets.target: EF prover deployment on Sepolia — near term, pending Prysm/Lighthouse interop resolution
Zilkworm Alpha 5 — native stateless input bytes support, two test fixes, full EERE integration out of draft
